description.name: yayatoh
description.subtitle: ={{$parameter["operation"]}}
description.description: Events, orders, attendees and check-in from Yayatoh (generated from /v1 0.2.0).

options.name: Add a contact
options.description: Finds or creates the org’s contact for the email; an existing contact keeps its name unless it had none. Records no marketing consent. Needs the contacts:write scope.

options.name: Seat many attendees at once
options.description: Select attendees by `ids` (all must belong to the event, else 404) or by a list `filter`, resolved once when the operation starts (at most 50,000). Retrying with the same Idempotency-Key returns the same operation; another body with that key is 422. Seats them at a table or row, in a section, in the best available seats or in their group's block, in plan order. Per-person failures: `not_enough_seats`, `seated_by_ticket`, `attendee_cancelled`, `not_found`; a kept-back accessible seat is a warning (`ada_kept_back`). Undo within 10 minutes puts everyone back. Needs the events:write scope.

options.name: Cancel tickets without a refund
options.description: Voids the named attendees’ tickets (scanners reject them), cancels the attendees and returns their places and seats to sale. No money moves: refunds stay per order. It cannot be undone, so only explicit `ids` are accepted, never a filter. Needs the orders:refund scope.

options.name: Email many attendees about the event
options.action: Email many attendees about the event
options.description: Select attendees by `ids` (all must belong to the event, else 404) or by a list `filter`, resolved once when the operation starts (at most 50,000). Retrying with the same Idempotency-Key returns the same operation; another body with that key is 422. One email per attending person; the others fail `not_attending`. Refused while messaging is paused for the organization. Needs the attendees:write scope.

options.name: Add or remove labels on many attendees
options.action: Add or remove labels on many attendees
options.description: Select attendees by `ids` (all must belong to the event, else 404) or by a list `filter`, resolved once when the operation starts (at most 50,000). Retrying with the same Idempotency-Key returns the same operation; another body with that key is 422. Removal wins over addition; an attendee carries at most 20 labels (`too_many_labels`). Undo within 10 minutes restores each attendee's previous labels. Needs the attendees:write scope.

options.name: Email attendees their tickets again
options.description: Select attendees by `ids` (all must belong to the event, else 404) or by a list `filter`, resolved once when the operation starts (at most 50,000). Retrying with the same Idempotency-Key returns the same operation; another body with that key is 422. Each ticket holder gets one email with a fresh link to their tickets. Guests without a ticket fail `no_ticket`; void tickets fail `ticket_void`. Needs the attendees:write scope.

properties.name: target
properties.description: A table or row (`item`), a section, the best available seats, or a group’s block.

options.name: overrideRules
options.description: Use accessible seats an enforced rule keeps back (audited).

options.name: Scan a ticket online and get the door verdict
options.action: Scan a ticket online and get the door verdict
options.description: The same engine as the Scan PWA. Retrying with the same Idempotency-Key returns the first verdict instead of a duplicate. Needs the checkin:scan scope.

properties.name: code
properties.description: The QR payload (`yy1…`) or the printed short code.

options.name: Create a draft event
options.description: Creates a draft event. Times are instants; `timezone` is how they render. Needs an `Idempotency-Key`. Needs the events:write scope.

options.name: One event
options.description: One event of the organization; another org’s event is a 404. Needs the events:read scope.

options.name: Events by start time
options.description: The organization’s events by start time, every status and visibility. Needs the events:read scope.

options.name: Publish a draft event
options.description: Publishes a draft event (lifecycle `draft → published`). Needs an `Idempotency-Key`. Needs the events:write scope.

options.name: Change an event
options.description: Changes the fields given; the slug is frozen once published. Needs an `Idempotency-Key`. Needs the events:write scope.

options.name: limit
options.description: Page size (1–100).

options.name: Register someone for an event
options.description: Adds a person to the event’s guest list (no ticket, no payment). One active registration per email per event: a second one is a 409. Needs the attendees:write scope.

options.name: One attendee
options.description: One attendee of the event. Needs the attendees:read scope.

options.name: The event’s attendees, newest first
options.description: The event’s attendees, newest first, optionally filtered by a search term or status. Needs the attendees:read scope.

options.name: Search attendees across events by name or email
options.action: Search attendees across events by name or email
options.description: Attendees across the organization’s events matching a name or email. Limited to 60 per minute. Needs the attendees:read scope.

options.name: limit
options.description: Page size (1–100).

options.name: search
options.description: Name or email contains

options.name: status
options.description: Only attendees with this status

properties.name: q
properties.description: Part of a name or email (2+ characters)

options.name: limit
options.description: Most hits to return (1–50)

options.name: Add a ticket type
options.description: Adds a ticket type (prices in minor units). Needs an `Idempotency-Key`. Needs the events:write scope.

options.name: The event’s ticket types
options.description: Every ticket type of the event in display order, with sold and held counts. Needs the events:read scope.

options.name: Change a ticket type
options.description: Changes the fields given. Needs an `Idempotency-Key`. Needs the events:write scope.

options.name: An event’s agenda
options.description: Tracks, rooms and sessions grouped by day in the event’s timezone, with ids and capacities. Needs the events:read scope.

options.name: One speaker
options.description: A speaker and the sessions they speak in. Needs the events:read scope.

options.name: An event’s announcements
options.description: Every announcement, newest first: drafts (`publishedAt` null) and both audiences. Needs the events:read scope.

options.name: An event’s dates
options.description: The dates of a multi-date event in start order, with capacities. Needs the events:read scope.

options.name: An event’s exhibitors
options.description: Exhibitors by name. Needs the events:read scope.

options.name: An event’s content sections
options.description: Every content section in page order, hidden ones included (`visible`). Needs the events:read scope.

options.name: An event’s speakers
options.description: Speakers by name. Needs the events:read scope.

options.name: An event’s sponsor tiers
options.description: Every sponsor tier in display order (empty ones included) with its sponsors. Needs the events:read scope.

options.name: dateId
options.description: Only this date’s sessions (and those on no date), for multi-date events.

options.name: limit
options.description: Page size (1–100).

options.name: limit
options.description: Page size (1–100).

options.name: limit
options.description: Page size (1–100).

options.name: limit
options.description: Page size (1–100).

options.name: One order with its tickets
options.description: One order with its line items and tickets. Needs the orders:read scope.

options.name: The event’s orders, newest first
options.description: The event’s orders, newest first, without payment-provider internals. Needs the orders:read scope.

options.name: Refund tickets or an amount under the refund policy
options.action: Refund tickets or an amount under the refund policy
options.description: Refunds whole tickets or an amount under the event’s refund policy, through the payment provider. Needs an `Idempotency-Key`; a retry returns the first result. Needs the orders:refund scope.

options.name: limit
options.description: Page size (1–100).

options.name: One venue
options.description: A saved venue. Needs the events:read scope.

options.name: The organization’s venues
options.description: Saved venues by name, archived ones included (`archivedAt`). Needs the events:read scope.

options.name: limit
options.description: Page size (1–100).

options.name: A sample delivery for an event type
options.action: A sample delivery for an event type
options.description: Example data with the delivery’s exact shape, for setting up an automation before a real event happens. Needs the webhooks:subscribe scope.

options.name: Subscribe a URL to one event type
options.action: Subscribe a URL to one event type
options.description: A REST hook (Zapier-style): deliveries are the same signed, thin messages as Settings → Webhooks endpoints. It appears there too, where the organizer can remove it. Needs the webhooks:subscribe scope.

options.name: Unsubscribe a REST hook
options.description: Removes a hook made through this API (never an endpoint the organizer made). A hook that is already gone answers 204 too. Needs the webhooks:subscribe scope.

properties.name: url
properties.description: Where to deliver: https on port 443, a public host.

properties.name: event
properties.description: A public event type (see the `webhooks` section).
